title: One workspace index with five readers, eight more requests in the closed set, and inlay hints for the two idioms that stopped moving
scope:
what M10's editor layer adds to `nvs-lsp` on top of M4B's slice — the symbol
index's shape and its one construction site, the requests admitted beyond the nine, the
completion arms that answer a namespace separator and a bare name, and the reversal of
[0099](0099.md) § 3's inlay-hint deferral. It decides nothing about `nvs fmt`, `nvs dap`, the
profiler, the inline-HTML `nvs/regions` request or `nvs ext`: each is still staged behind a
piece that does not exist, per `rule:ide/every-feature-is-staged-behind-its-dependency`.
dependsOnText:
[0099](0099.md) (the M4B request set and the test a tenth request has to pass),
[0108](0108.md) (five features are one reference index; `nvs.check.scope`), [0111](0111.md) (the
PHP-name completion layer), [0040](0040.md) (the staged editor catalog).

summary.headline: The language server keeps one workspace index, and hints appear in two idioms
summary.body:
One index of every symbol in the workspace, keyed by the name the type checker resolved, answers
workspace symbol search, references, rename, implementations and the call hierarchy. Eight more
standard editor requests are supported on the same basis; go-to-declaration is refused because
Novis has no declaration that is not the definition. Completion also offers names after a
namespace separator and bare names in scope. Inlay hints are shown for exactly two idioms and
nowhere else.
